title: Rommath's Orders
wikitext:
'''Rommath's Orders''' drop from the following blood elves in [[Felstrider Retreat]]:
* [[Blood Elf Ranger]]
* [[Blood Elf Darkcaster]]
* [[Blood Elf Marauder]]

==As a quest objective==
* {{questlong|Alliance|9|Felstrider Retreat (quest)|Felstrider Retreat}}

==Contains==
{{Book|content=
Destroy this letter once you have memorized its contents.

All preparations have been made. Send your delegation to [[Alah'Thalas]] at once. [[Eldin Sunstrider|Eldin]] is not an option; he will be recognized. Choose one of your most trusted men, and ensure they cover their eyes during the journey.

I will await your arrival until tomorrow. Should you be delayed or unable to reach Alah'Thalas in time, I will contact [[Kael'thas Sunstrider|him]] independently. I trust in the best outcome.

[[Grand Magister Rommath|Rommath]]
}}

==Patch changes==
* {{Patch|1.17.1|note=Added.}}
